description: Header file defining constants, macros, and function prototypes for CJ125 wideband oxygen sensor interface, including register configurations, diagnostic bits, calibration parameters, and sensor-related functions.

methods.name: cjPostState
methods.description: Posts the current state of the CJ125 sensor to Tuner Studio output channels.

methods.name: initCJ125
methods.description: Initializes the CJ125 sensor hardware and configuration.

methods.name: cjGetAfr
methods.description: Retrieves the current air-fuel ratio measurement from the sensor.

methods.name: cjHasAfrSensor
methods.description: Checks if the CJ125 sensor is present and functional.

methods.name: cj125defaultPinout
methods.description: Sets the default pin configuration for the CJ125 sensor.
